curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What horrifying truth did Michele uncover beneath the ruins of the deserted farmhouse, and why must he keep it from everyone?
curatedMovie.description: In a sun-scorched Italian village surrounded by endless wheat fields, nine-year-old Michele explores an abandoned farmhouse and stumbles upon a shocking secret he is terrified to reveal.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A sun-drenched yet heavy mystery balancing deliberate pacing with mounting suspense.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: The scorched countryside and a child’s discovery of a terrible secret give the story a tense, unsettling pull.
